title: Life in Shane's country
body: Shane lives in North Korea, where there is a set of defined rules for everyday living. He is doing compulsory military service and must serve in the military for as long as the government decides. There are rules about how his hair should be cut and what clothes he should wear. He cannot use the global internet, so he does not know about the world outside his own country. The government watches his every action closely, and he is expected to report anyone who tries to break any of the rules. One day a tourist asked him why everyone there had the same haircut. Shane replied that they all wanted to try new styles, but the government decides how they should keep their hair. (Based on the 'Story of Shane' in the NCERT chapter.)
